scope: Every retained nonempty issue and endorsement in data-statewide.js; supplemental role/hometown review for 13 substantive profiles.
methodology: Compared each complete summary and each endorsement against substantive official/campaign/endorser source text. URLs and HTTP success alone were not treated as proof. Campaign claims are verified as attributed positions, not independently verified policy effects. PDFs were text-extracted; Max Solomon was also rendered in Edge.
limitations: Verification is bounded to the displayed text and sources available on November 1, 2026, not a guarantee against future changes.
IRMA and Trump endorsements name the governor candidate individually, not both members of the joint ticket; evidence notes preserve this distinction.
The biography hometown field can mean documented hometown or current city of residence; it is not a formal voter-registration address claim.

Printed/write-in candidacy clauses were checked against the shared SBE extraction and current GPUS list; comprehensive roster and county eligibility reconciliation belongs to the separate roster audit.

No nonempty issue or endorsement claim remains inaccessible after alternate primary-source access and rendering. The Raoul Blue Book PDF failed in web access; his role was independently corroborated through his current campaign biography and official AG releases.
